item.title: Infisical (YC W23) Is Hiring Engineers to Build the Modern OSS Security Stack
item.description:
📝 We're building a generational company with a world-class engineering team. Our team brings experience from companies like Figma, AWS, and Red Hat. Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, internal PKI, key management, and SSH workflow orchestration.
